methodology: Bounded verse-specific first-pass triage. No source-specific external primary passage independently collated; general thematic possibilities are not counted as verified candidates. Provisional absence means no specific parallel established in this pass, not proof of nonexistence.

records.topic: Hūd warns of divine wrath and challenges ancestral cult names
records.notes: Compare critiques of inherited cult practice in Hebrew prophetic literature only as broad polemic; no independently dated account of Hūd's exchange identified.

records.topic: Hūd and followers saved; rejecters destroyed
records.notes: A recurring rescue-and-judgment narrative pattern; do not equate this event with Noah's flood or another named catastrophe without a specific witness.

records.topic: Ṣāliḥ addresses Thamūd and presents God's she-camel as a sign
records.notes: No precise pre-Islamic primary-text account of Ṣāliḥ's miraculous she-camel checked. Research Thamudic ethnonyms in securely dated inscriptions separately from this narrative.

records.topic: Thamūd succeeds ʿĀd; builds plains palaces and carves mountain dwellings
records.notes: Compare archaeological rock-cut structures and ancient references to Thamūd, but avoid identifying Qur'anic Thamūd with Nabataean tomb builders or dating the narrated events from surviving monuments.

records.topic: Arrogant chiefs challenge believers in Ṣāliḥ's mission
records.notes: No earlier source-specific attestation of this dialogue established in preliminary screening; generic elite-versus-prophet conflict is not a precise parallel.
